description: Helps you decide which customers to go after next. You give your best customers, as a list (industry, size, contract value, sales cycle, tech stack, buying trigger, champion title) or in your own words. You get the patterns they share, with ties named as ties, the budget shown as the contract value range seen in your customers, recommendations, and sector notes when your inputs name a supported sector. It works only from what you give and looks nothing up.

business_model.description: Optional: how you charge (software subscription, services, connectivity, per transaction, marketplace, hardware plus software, or investment management). Read from your other inputs when left out

company.description: Optional: your company or product name, so the answer can name it

customer_descriptions.description: Alternative: Describe your best customers in text format

customers.description: List of customer objects with available attributes

product_category.description: What type of product you sell

name: icp_deep_dive
title: ICP Deep Dive
